relations.text: MSGネットワークスの放映契約をAltice USAと複数年で更新し、2025年2月22日に放送が再開された
relations.text_en: MSG Networks renewed its affiliation agreement with Altice for multiple years on February 22, 2025, and carriage resumed

source.label: スフィア・エンターテインメント 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: On February 22, 2025, MSG Networks and Altice entered into a multi-year renewal of the MSG Networks affiliation agreement and Altice resumed carriage of the Company’s networks.

relations.text: MSGネットワークスはコムキャストとの放映契約を2021年9月の満了時に更新できなかった
relations.text_en: MSG Networks could not renew its affiliation agreement with Comcast when it expired in September 2021

source.label: スフィア・エンターテインメント 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Prior to that, MSG Networks was not able to renew its affiliation agreement with Comcast when it expired in September 2021, which caused a reduction in annual affiliation revenue, operating income and adjusted operating income.

relations.text: 2026年1月にデルタ航空をスフィアの公式航空会社とすると発表した
relations.text_en: In January 2026 the Company announced Delta Air Lines as the Official Airline of Sphere

source.label: スフィア・エンターテインメント 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: in January 2026, the Company announced Delta Air Lines as the Official Airline of Sphere

relations.text: 分配後もMSGエンターテインメントの普通株式を約33%保有している
